transformation: A PDI pipeline: steps connected by hops, processing a stream of rows. Saved as a .ktr file.
job: An orchestration flow that sequences transformations and other entries (mail, file checks, retries). Saved as a .kjb file.
step: One unit of work in a transformation — read a file, filter rows, look up a value, write a table.
hop: The link between two steps that rows flow along. In a job, hops carry success/failure routing instead of rows.
preview: Inspecting the live rows at any step while designing, before anything is written to a target.
stream lookup: An in-memory join: enriches the main stream with fields fetched from a second stream by key.
slowly changing dimension: A warehouse table that keeps history: when a tracked attribute changes, a new versioned row is added with a validity window instead of overwriting (Type 2).
metadata injection: Configuring a template transformation at runtime from data (e.g. a control file), so one pipeline handles many differently-shaped inputs.
Developer Edition: The free Pentaho distribution for evaluation, development, and learning under the Business Source License 1.1 — production use requires a commercial licence.
Spoon: The PDI desktop designer where transformations and jobs are built and run during development.
